summary: Iter51 — Full validation of (1) production-hardened /brokerage/loads/book with atomic shipments-sync + overrides, (2) full QBR Studio (shippers/period/generate/CRUD/PDF/distribute), (3) aggregator Book-Load button E2E + /workflow?booked_id=... routing, (4) /data-status new modules coverage. Backend: 19/19 pytest passing. Frontend: aggregator-book → /workflow navigation confirmed; QBR Studio 2-tab layout renders, 8-tile KPI strip, read-out cards (Volume/Revenue, OTD, Damage/Claims), narrative fields, Save Draft creates row in Drafts tab (2 total), per-row View/PDF/Send/Delete all wired.

minor.issue: Shippers list includes TEST_-prefixed sample rows (TEST_Close_*, TEST_Dispute_*, TEST_Fastpay_*, TEST_Watchlist_*). No filter to hide obvious test seeds. Consider excluding rows where source='claim' AND shipper_name starts with 'TEST_' from the dropdown.
shipments match uses substring (`shipper_lc in consignee`) so a shipper called 'AR' would match 'ARKMART', 'PARR', etc. Use exact match or word-boundary to avoid cross-contamination.

issues: When shipper has 0 loads in the selected period, all 8 KPI tiles show 0/$0/— but there is no explicit 'No data for this period' banner — a first-time user might think the page is broken instead of understanding the shipper has no Q1 2026 activity yet. Consider a subtle info line above the KPI grid when metrics.loads.total === 0.

action_items: OPTIONAL: hide TEST_-prefixed shipper names from /qbr-studio/shippers dropdown.
OPTIONAL: exact-match consignee/supplier in _compute_metrics to prevent substring cross-matching.
OPTIONAL: 'No activity in this period' info line in QBR Studio Auto-Compute view when loads.total === 0.
critical_code_review_comments: brokerage.book_load creates a shipment row but the mirror is inside a bare `try/except Exception: log.warning(...)` — if the shipment insert fails (e.g. duplicate shipment_id, disk full), the booking still returns `shipment_created: true` even though it isn't. Either propagate the exception (fail the whole booking) or set shipment_created=false on failure. Currently the API is lying to the client under partial-failure.

brokerage.book_load: no idempotency guard. If the client retries POST /brokerage/loads/book with the same load_id + carrier_name (e.g. network glitch), a second brokerage_bookings row + a second shipments row are created. Consider a unique-index on (load_id, carrier_name) with is_sample=false, or accept an idempotency_key.

qbr_studio._compute_metrics loads the entire brokerage_bookings, shipments, claims collections into memory and filters in Python (`find({}).to_list(5000)` then loop). This won't scale past a few thousand rows per collection. Refactor to Mongo aggregation with $match/$gte/$lt on booked_at + $regex on customer_name.

qbr_studio.distribute enqueues an outbound_emails row but does NOT actually send email (queued_at, status='queued'). The frontend/UX says 'Send' which will mislead the operator into thinking it went out. Either rename the button to 'Queue Send' or wire the Resend send with the existing key in Connections.

qbr_studio._render_qbr_pdf builds markdown and delegates to routes.orisei_docs.build_branded_markdown_pdf — good reuse. But no error handling around the PDF build; a malformed brand row (e.g. missing short_name after a bulk import) would 500 on report.pdf. Add a fallback brand={short_name:'Orisei'}.
QbrStudio.jsx is 626 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. If a Distribution audit tab is added later, split into pages/qbr-studio/ subdirectory.
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 TEST_Carrier_* brokerage_bookings + matching shipments (via synthetic and override modes), 1 QBR draft (QBR-88C1039984) via UI. Did NOT delete QBR-70CD2DE972 (preserved per brief). Pytest also creates+deletes one QBR draft per run and creates one outbound_emails row per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter51_book_load_qbr.py at /app/backend/tests/ covers all 4 new backend surfaces. If shipment mirror on book_load starts failing, first check that the brokerage.book_load payload includes all shipments-required fields (current_location, pieces, eta, weight_lbs, commodity, value_usd — these already asserted). For QBR Studio, the compute expects date-in-quarter — running tests in Q3 2026 for Q1 2026 shipper 'E2E Test Shipper Co' returns 0 metrics (empty state), which is correct — use YTD 2026 if you want to see the newly-created bookings reflected. To find loads for synthetic booking, hit GET /api/brokerage/boards/{board}/loads NOT /api/brokerage/loads.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found this iteration. Two API-shape gotchas caught while writing tests: (1) synthetic feed lookup endpoint is /brokerage/boards/{board_id}/loads not /brokerage/loads, (2) /api/data-status counts docs WITHOUT is_sample flag as real (via subtraction: real = total - count({is_sample:true})) — this matches the post-fix expectation. Bookings created without customer_name still succeed; shipment mirror still writes.
